title: Brave (web search)
description: Brave Search as gohort's web search, declared as a service: the request and how its results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Get an API key at api-dashboard.search.brave.com (a free plan is available). Choose it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as Service and save; Test there makes one real search for a common phrase: <name>. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what searches cost. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; Web Search lists it by this name.

config.name: api_key
config.label: Brave Search API key
config.help: Kept with this connection, and sent only to the address it is given for.
